verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada's own fees page documents a PDF form channel for filing by email or mail, presented as an explicit fallback to the Online Filing Centre. This implies the forms are published on its site. The evidence does not show a download link, does not state that no account is needed, and does not mention accompanying instructions. Missing for 10: explicit evidence the PDF forms are downloadable without an account, documented form instructions or guides, and independent or hands-on corroboration of account-free access.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account

citations.quote: Email or mail It will cost $250 and will take 10 days. How to file: File the PDF form
with the paper PDF channel documented alongside as the explicit fallback — both rails on one page
